note: Probes for the seams a single-sentence fixture cannot reach. Shared by every port's parity script so the two are diffing the same questions — two ports probing different seams would reproduce the drift the scripts exist to catch. Each entry says WHICH seam, because a probe whose purpose is forgotten gets deleted as redundant.
